title: Azure/GCS prefix not validated for leading/trailing slash
description: The S3 backend (from previous commit) validates that the prefix does not start or end with '/' via config validation. The new Azure and GCS backends have no equivalent check. object_store::path::Path::from() normalizes some forms but not all — a prefix of '/blocks' or 'blocks/' could produce double-slash paths ('//blocks/...' or 'blocks//<cid>') depending on backend behavior. This is a footgun for operators who copy a path from the Azure Portal or GCS console (which often include trailing slashes). The S3 validation pattern should be applied consistently to Azure and GCS.
